## Computational and Diagnostic Assessment

[Assess the computational adequacy and diagnostics reported in the paper. Address the following as applicable:]

**Convergence:** [Are likelihood traces across IF2 iterations shown? Do multiple runs from different starting values reach consistent likelihoods?]

**Particle filter:** [Is ESS monitored? Is the particle count reported and justified? Is there evidence of filter degeneracy?]

**Conditional log-likelihoods:** [Are per-time-step log-likelihoods plotted? Do they identify specific periods of poor fit?]

**Profile likelihoods:** [Are profiles computed for key parameters? Are confidence intervals reported (e.g., via MCAP)?]

**Computational scale:** [Are CPU-hours or equivalent reported? Is the effort sufficient given model complexity?]

---

## Reproducibility Assessment

[Evaluate the code and data supplement against reproducibility standards. Address the following as applicable:]

**Code availability:** [Is source code archived with a DOI? Is the repository complete?]

**Final parameters:** [Are MLE parameter vectors archived separately so results can be evaluated without re-running optimization?]

**Model-code consistency:** [Does the measurement model in code match the mathematical description in the text?]

**Package versions:** [Are pomp/spatPomp versions pinned (e.g., via renv)? Is sessionInfo() or equivalent provided?]

**Auxiliary data:** [Are all inputs included — covariate matrices, spatial structure, population data?]

**HPC reproducibility:** [For cluster-based analyses, are job submission scripts and environment specs included?]
